lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 high-contrast white vertical lines are visible; spacing is widest in the anterior shoulder region and significantly narrows toward the posterior haunches.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped topological split is visible on the 4th line from the anterior, located in the upper 20% of the torso's vertical height near the dorsal ridge; a minor merge point is observed on the 6th line in the mid-dorsal region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 8 through 12 exhibit significant fragmentation, transitioning from solid lines into abbreviated vertical dashes and isolated circular spots in the posterior-midsection.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-density cluster of 8-10 white spots is located on the lateral surface of the posterior haunch, concentrated above the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct horizontal alignments are visible: a row of 3 spots across the mid-thigh and a shorter row of 2 spots near the posterior edge of the upper hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns emerge from the skull at an approximately 45-degree divergent angle, exhibiting a posterior-dorsal lyrate curvature with a minor axial spiral.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 3.5 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the orbital regions, two distinct white spots on the lateral mandible/cheek area, and a dark brown gular fringe extending to the ventral midline.
